items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But Mrs. Goodman told me that this particular saxophonist or saxophone teacher or person had come to them with a petition

ctx.x: With all these, you know, housing . . . I think they called them covenants or . . .

Yes. Actually, there’s an interesting thing I might say about that. These restrictive covenants were in effect at the time, and especially, of course, in this neighborhood in which I had bought was in the heart of the Hollywood Hills, at the time a sort of posh area. The deed was recorded in the name of Michael Gould, I mention again, so the other people in the neighborhood saw me going and coming, but they didn’t know that it was my house. But at some point they decided that I was the occupant, upon which they…
You didn’t have anything to do with his passing on, did you?
